Hi Sara —

Really appreciate the work your team has done getting the Redwood integration live. I wanted to ask a quick favor: would ByteForge be willing to provide a short testimonial (1–2 sentences) about impact and/or submit a TrustRadius review? We’re collecting a handful of recent customers to surface in our sellers’ enablement and on our website.

If it helps, we can:
- Send a 3-question template you can copy/paste
- Draft a one-paragraph case summary for you to edit
- Provide a $100 Amazon gift card per submitted review as a thank-you (or equivalent vendor voucher) — we’ll need an email to send it to.

No pressure — totally fine if you’re not able to. If you are, what would be easiest for you (short quote, full review, or an internal case study interview)? I’ve attached a very rough outline of a case-study draft in case you want to see how we’d position ByteForge.

Attachments: byteforge-case-study-outline.docx (outline)

Thanks again,

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the quick note and great questions. Quick answers below and a very short copy-paste template you can use for TrustRadius/G2.

1) Voucher: $100 per reviewer (individual). If multiple people at ByteForge post, we’re happy to send one per person who actually submits a review. We can do Amazon, Visa e-gift, or a vendor voucher — whatever is easiest for them.
2) Case-study vs review: start with a short TrustRadius review and one-paragraph quote. If you’re open to a follow-up 20–30 minute interview later, we can plan that separately and route through Legal.
3) Compliance: we’re happy to run any language past your legal team. We’ll only publish approved quotes.

Quick review template (copy / paste):
- What problem were you solving?
- How did Redwood help?
- One measurable outcome or benefit (e.g., latency reduced by X, cost dropped by Y)

If that’s helpful I’ve attached the case-study outline and a PDF we use to issue voucher codes once a review is confirmed. If you’re good with this path, can you share the email addresses for the reviewers (or tell me to send vouchers to the same address you reply from)?

Links:
- TrustRadius review page: https://www.trustradius.com/reviews/new?product=redwood-inference
- Case study draft (internal): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AxyZ_case_study_outline

Attachments: byteforge-case-study-outline.docx, giftcard-voucher.pdf

Appreciate it.
Karthik
